tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos skyong khyad par can rnams kyis dus gtor gyi phyag len rol yig bzhugs so// tshes brgyad kyi dgong bskang gso gsar pa'i spyan 'dren rgyal ba kun gyi ma la nyis brdeg bstan bsrung rgya mtsho ma dang / khyad par bstan pa ma la gsum brdeg bstan bsrung ma'i tshig bzhi pa la dzar brdeg byin rlabs ma'i tshig gsum pa la dzar brdeg len che brdeg che ba gnyis dang chung ba gnyis kyi mjug tu nyis brdeg zhal gyi spyan 'dren rnying pa dbyangs ring la nyis brdeg dbyangs thung mi rtog ma la tshig bzhi pa la dzar brdeg gcig dang gsum brdeg bskang gso lha mchog ma'i dbyangs thung la gsum brdeg khams gdangs ma la bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod kyi bar la 'bru re la sil snyan chung re brgyab pa'i mjug tu chems brdeg che ba dang chung ba bzhi'i mjug tu brdeg rak+ta dmar chen la nyis brdeg dam rdzas ma la rol mo chung ba gnyis re'i mjug tu che ba drag myur gnyis brdeg de dang 'dra ba lan gsum gyi rjes su chung ba gnyis dang lan che ba gcig gdong bzhi dregs pa tshig gsum pa tshang ma la rnga phyir brdeg dang rol mo/ bzhi pa la rnga bdun brdung sil snyan med pa mjug tu gsum brdeg zhal gyi bskang gsar gyi spyan 'dren 'dur gdangs la gsum brdeg bskang gso'i 'dod dbyangs la yum chen bzhi'i tshig gi ring la rol mo/ rdzogs mtshams su gsum brdeg bzlog pa rnams la drag brdungs bcu bzhi brdeg sngags dbyangs la gsum brdeg sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma la gsum brdeg dpal ldan lha mo la nyis brdeg dpal ldan srid gsum ma la gsum brdeg mon bu pu tra tshig dang po'i mjug ma dzar brdeg mjug tu gsum brdeg dpal ldan dkar mo la spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs dang rol mo nyis brdeg/ //bcu bzhi'i bskang gso gsar pa la 'dra/ gtum chen ma la kye bos so ring dbyangs thung ba dang rol mo nyis brdeg

chos dbyings spros bral dang / dpal ldan lha mo gnyis la nyis brdeg rin chen lnga las grub pa'i tshig re'i mjug tu dbyangs dang bstun len chung ba gnyis dang che ba drag myur gnyis/ mjug tu chung ba gsum dang che ba re ste bzhi brdeg lan gsum dang che ba gcig brdeg gzhan yang ma 'bring ba la nyis brdeg 'gro ba'i don du tshig pa la dzar brdeg dang / mjug tu 'theng rkang gnyis dang gsum brdungs/ bzlog pa/ sngags dbyangs/ sangs rgyas bstan ma rnams rol mo gong bzhin// //nyer gsum la bskang gso gong bzhin/ pu tra'i spyan 'dren dang dam tshig la len chung gnyis dang gsum brdeg gnyis/ yang 'theng rkang chung ngu gnyis dang / dgu brdeg che ba gcig bskang gso rnam dag tshogs gtor la mi 'gyur ma'i dbyangs rol/ mon bu pu pra gong bzhin/ nag po gnod sbyin la lha mchog nag po'i dbyangs rol/ dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren nyis brdeg bskang gso'i dpal ldan lha mo la gzhan yang ma 'bring po dang / dam tshig chen po la bar gyi 'theng rkang chung ngu gnyis shin tu che ba rgyag pa ma gtogs pu tra'i spyan 'dren dang 'dra/ ma mo chen mo dbyangs rol lha mo'i re ma ti dang 'dra/ mkha' 'gro ni chen mo'i mjug tu chems brdeg gnyis dang / bdun brdeg drag myur gcig de 'dra ba lan gsum gyi mjug tu chems brdeg gcig nag po mi zad la phur pa'i dzaḥsprul gyi dbyangs dang nyis brdeg bskang gso bsdus pa la 'dur dbyangs gsum brdeg bzlog pa/ sngags dbyangs/ sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma sogs gong dang 'dra ba la/ mon bu pu tra/ sh+lau ka gsum la/ 'das dang ma byon gyi gdangs/ rol mo bdun brdung drag myur gsum/ dpal ldan dkar mo'i dbyangs thung la rol mo gsum brdeg/ //nyi shu drug la bskang gsar dang / pu tra/ dkar mo gnyis rgyas pa/ bstod gsar gyi dpal ldan srid gsum yan gong bzhin/ dur khrod sha za la dkar mo spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol/

de'i yum mchog dang / 'og gi bran bdud/ phur bsrung rnams la mi 'gyur ma'i dbyangs rol/ bdud rgyal gyi dpal chen bka' yi la bskang gso'i dam tshig chen mo dang dbyangs rol gcig/ //nyi shu bdun la bskang gso nag po mchod rten ma'i spyan 'dren sh+lau gsum dang / de wi ko ṭa ma la nyis brdeg 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang bskang gsar gyi dur khrod bdag po sha za yab yum dang sh+lau ka gnyis dang / dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren rnams la gsum brdeg rdo rje brag rdzong gi tshig rkang bzhi pa'i rdzogs mtshams kyi chen po la ces pa'i la chems brdeg dang / mjug tu tshig lhad gsum gyi bar la cung chung ba dang / de nas che ba drag myur nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / 'jog khar 'theng rkang gcig dang chems brdeg gcig dus gsum bde gshegs ma la gsum brdeg rnam dag tshogs gtor la bzhi brdeg mdzes pa'i spu sdug la nyis brdeg mi 'gyur ma la gsum brdeg kyai bos so thung ba dang / so ring gnyis la nyis brdeg kyai bos so 'bring ba/ sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma'i dbyangs rol/ gzhan yang dam ring mo gsum brdeg bzlog pa 'dra/ bshags pa dang / bka' bsgo gsum brdeg sngags dbyangs 'dra/ srin gzugs ma bu gnyis brdeg gang sku ma gsum brdeg bu dbyangs de ltar tshar bcad ma nyis brdeg dpal ldan dbang ldan ma nyis brdeg bu dbyangs gru 'dzin ma gsum brdeg mgon po'i bka' nyan gyi gnod sbyin gyi 'gyings dbyangs la tshig gnyis ma la dzar brdeg dang mjug tu nyis brdeg pu tra'i sgar dbyangs nyis brdeg dkar mo ba ni gong gi dbyangs thung dang 'dra// //nyi shu brgyad la bskang gso chos nyid ma'i spyan 'dren srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs rol/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas sogs gdangs thung rnams dang / sngags rnams kyi mjug tu gsum brdeg rnam dag tshogs gtor/ rdo rje brag chen/ kyai bos so/ bshags pa rnams la gsum brdeg chos dbyings spros bral bcu bzhi dang 'dra/

zhal gyi spyan 'dren rdo rje 'chang dbang ma nyis brdeg dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren 'dur gdangs/ bskang gso lha mchog ma/ rak+ta dmar chen/ dam rdzas rgyan dang ma/ gdong bzhi dregs pa ma rnams tshes brgyad dang dbyangs rol 'dra/ chos nyid ma'i bzlog pa'i dbyangs/ bdud rgyal gyi dam tshig chen po'i rol mo dang 'dra/ sngags dbyangs 'dra/ de nas sngon tshe ma la nyis brdeg til mar ma 'theng rkang gnyis dang / che ba gsum/ chems brdungs gcig rgyam klong ma bu dbyangs la nyis brdeg khyod kyi bzhugs tshul gsum brdeg pu tra'i dpal ldan 'phrin las kyi dbyangs ring mtshams dbyangs la tshig gnyis la dzar brdeg dang / 'then rkang gnyis dal/ brdeg che ba'i rjes su gcig brdeg gcig sgar dbyangs sngar dang 'dra/ bha ṭa'i 'jig byed dbyings las bzhengs pa'i rol dbyangs kyi tshig bzhi pa'i/ ro drug ma chags gsol la bstod bar la rol mo/ mjug tu 'then rkang gnyis dang / dgu brdeg gnyis/ sring mo'i sngon tshe gsang sngags kyi rtser dbyangs kyi tshig bzhi pa la dzar brdeg dang 'then rkang gnyis/ mjug tu gsum brdeg sgo ma'i rnam dag tshad med bzhi'i 'dur dbyangs la gsum brdeg/ //nyer dgu la nag po mchod rten ma'i spyan 'dren gyi rol chen la rol mo bcams rjes chung ba brgyad/ che ba brgyad de 'dra ba lan gnyis/ de nas chung ba brgyad/ che ba gcig chung ba bdun/ che ba gnyis/ chung ba drug che ba gsum/ chung ba lnga/ che ba bzhi/ chung ba bzhi dang / che ba bzhi'o/ /spyan 'dren dad ring la/ rol mo che ba bzhi/ chung ba bzhi/ che ba bzhi re/ mchod dbyangs gsum brdeg gzhan rnams la 'dur gdangs/ lha mo'i chos dbyings spros bral man 'dra/ dpal ldan lha mo man 'dur gdangs/ zhal gyi spyan 'dren lha mchog ma/ mi rtog ma'i dbyangs rol/ bskang gso'i 'dod dbyangs/ pu tra'i spyan 'dren dbyangs rol 'dra/ bskang gso 'dur gdangs/ dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren 'dra/

bskang gso 'dur gdangs/ bzlog pa dang rdzogs mtshams kyi rol mo dang sngags dbyangs 'dra/ gang thugs ma ma bu gsum brdeg mi pham ma bu dbyangs skad dung 'dra ma/ stab pa 'dir gshegs ma rnams nyis brdeg paṃ pad+ma nyis brdeg/ //nyi shu bdun gyi bskang gso'i mjug gi rnga gshon gyi rol mo bcu bzhi brdeg gsum gyi bar mtshams su lan bzhi re 'then rkang che ba ji ltar rigs pa'i mjug tu je chung je chung la btang ba'i zad mtshams glo bur du che ba bcu bzhi rgyag de 'dra lan gsum gyi mjug tu lnga brdeg che ba gsum btud/ de mtshams 'theng brdung ji ltar rigs pa'i mjug tu bcu bzhi rgyag dang / bzhi brdung che chung 'dres pa gong bzhin dang bdun brdung gsum/ 'then rkang dang bcu bzhi rgyag bzhi brdung rnams gong dang 'dra/ de nas dgu brdung gsum/ 'then rkang drag myur gyi mjug tu chems brdung rgyun ji ltar rigs pa'i bar la bzlog pa'i dmigs pa dang sngags rnams brjod/ dus gtor gsum gyi spyi stab kyi dbyangs rol chos dbyings spros bral gyi spyan 'dren dang 'dra// //nyer drug nas/ dgu gtor ma gru 'dzin ma'i dbyangs rol/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i mjug gi dbyangs thung gnyis po gsum brdeg gtor skyong gi dpal ldan 'phrin las kyi dbyangs ring thung gi rol mo gong bzhin/ spyi stab nam mkha' 'brug sgra dang sgar dbyangs gnyis la nyis brdeg srid zhi dpal 'byor ma ring ba'i thub pa'i bstan pa/ ces pa'i bar rol mo/ mjug tu gsum brdeg ces rol tshigs 'di rnams sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis tab tab po'i mgyogs par bris te phul ba yin pas dgongs zhig bcug pa'i dri ba gnang rgyu 'dug na zhu// //maṅga laṃ// //bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gson po'i skra dang so la sogs pa me la sreg ste/ khrus chu rnying pa'am yang na bum chog yi dam gang rung bas bskyed chog bzlas pa rim par byas pa'i chus pha rol phyin drug gi tshig bcad/

kun rig nas 'byung ba rnams kyis rjes su rtsa rig gam/ kaṃ ka ni'am/ yig brgya gang rung bzla/ gang la ser sna ma'i gzhug yan kun rig ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /khrus byas pa'i skra la sogs pa mdun du bzhag ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rgyud las/ bdud rtsi 'khyil par bdag bsgom zhing / /ngag tu de'i sngags bzlas la/ /yid kyis bgegs dang bral bar bsam/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil par skad cig gi bsam/ ngag tu o badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla/ yid kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas shing byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad bral bar bsam/ swa bhā wa dang shu n+ya ta gnyis yang yang brjod pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa stong pa nyid kyi don bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las skra la sogs pa bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i phung por gyur/ oṃ rat+na tsit+ta pañca ye bhi bhi sa ra sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan nyer gcig brjod/ de nas skra la sogs pa mnyes la tsha tsha btab pa gzhan dang 'dra'o// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ dus gtor gyi phyag len rol yig dang / skra sen la sāts+tsha btab pa'i yig chung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
